source: 29.09.2026 camp power: an inverter between the camp's batteries and its corded appliances, and a gasoline generator that charges them

overrides.description: A unified power supply built around an inverter: it turns a battery's direct current into household current for plug-in tools and appliances.  Set it by the camp's batteries and every corded appliance within reach can run off them.
overrides.//: Prologue: the camp's inverter (game-data/camp-power.json inverters); CDDA has no stand-alone inverter item, and its UPS is noted as one

notes: Camp power (electricity/CampPower.js, game-data/camp-power.json): batteries set down at camp are the bank, the inverter runs link_up appliances from it, solar panels and the generator refill it.
